name: ds1bg
style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright saturated colours, clean simple shapes, lots of calm open space. No text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A flat side view of a friendly prehistoric coast like a stage set seen straight from the front with no perspective, with NO animals, NO birds and NO people: a huge open bright blue sky with a few soft white clouds filling the upper two thirds of the picture, a tall rocky orange cliff on the right edge with a flat top, one tall prehistoric tree with a long bare branch on the left edge, a calm blue sea across the bottom with gentle waves, and a small sandy beach with a few rocks in the bottom left corner.
